old_row.rationale: Psalm 118 asks the Lord to instruct the speaker in the way of His ordinances and says he will seek it continually. Psalm 24 asks the Lord to make His ways known and teach His paths. The common formulation joins divine teaching with way or path imagery; the psalm’s continually seeking the ordinances is not supplied to the target.

new_row.rationale: Psalm 118 asks the Lord to instruct the speaker in the way of His ordinances and says he will seek it continually. Psalm 24 asks the Lord to make His ways known and teach His paths. The common formulation joins divine teaching with way or path imagery; the psalm’s continual seeking of that way is not supplied to the target.

changes.reason: Second actual reread preserves the way as the explicit object of seek it in both explanatory sentences.
